name: ViT
paper_title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
license_interpretation: Apache-2.0 is a permissive license, so these weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products. It asks you to keep its license text and attribution notices with any copy of the weights you redistribute, and it grants a patent license. It places no obligation on your own application code. LibreYOLO's runtime code for this family is a derived port of the Apache-2.0 timm Vision Transformer implementation (Ross Wightman, huggingface/pytorch-image-models), kept checkpoint-compatible with the shipped tensors. The four AugReg checkpoints themselves are timm's Apache-2.0 conversion of Google Research's own AugReg pretraining, so the code and the weights carry the same permissive terms end to end.
bibtex_verified: 2026-08-08, copied verbatim from the Bibtex section of the upstream README on branch main, which lists six papers from that repository; only the two entries relevant to this family are reproduced here, the original ViT architecture and the AugReg checkpoint recipe LibreYOLO's four shipped weights are converted from. Cross-checked against the arXiv API: 2010.11929 matches on title and all twelve authors in the same order (Dosovitskiy, Beyer, Kolesnikov, Weissenborn, Zhai, Unterthiner, Dehghani, Minderer, Heigold, Gelly, Uszkoreit, Houlsby); the paper's ICLR 2021 camera-ready carries no arXiv journal_ref, so the authors' own journal={ICLR} year={2021} form is left as published. 2106.10270 matches on title and all six authors in the same order (Steiner, Kolesnikov, Zhai, Wightman, Uszkoreit, Beyer); arXiv records it as accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (05/2022), so the authors' journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:2106.10270} year={2021} form is now dated and is reproduced as they publish it rather than upgraded. The double 'and and' in the AugReg author list is in the authors' own file and is kept as written. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.
